topic: 0.25 dB passband loss in satellite receiver frontends
consensus_response: The impact of the 0.25 dB passband loss is significant, reducing SNR and impacting the receiver's performance. Mitigation strategies like pre-amplification and high-gain antennas can effectively minimize the loss. Comparing to other losses, this loss compares favorably to antenna losses.
reference_context: This loss reduces the achievable data rate by 20%.
